{'text': '布洛利奧大主教（Archbishop Timothy Broglio）負責統籌天主教會為美軍天主教徒提供嘅牧靈服務，佢譴責當局擬直播槍擊行刑處決尼達爾·哈桑（Nidal Hasan）嘅計劃。', 'paragraph_context': 'Archbishop Timothy Broglio, who oversees the Catholic Church’s pastoral services to Catholics in the U.S. military, is condemning the proposed livestream of the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan.'}

{'text': '布洛利奧喺星期一發表嘅聲明中，亦明確指出任何被指派參與美軍行刑槍隊嘅天主教士兵，都應該申請獲免除呢項職務，佢形容呢項任務係「違背教會教導」嘅。佢加入其他天主教領袖嘅行列，一齊公開反對死刑同直播行刑嘅計劃。', 'paragraph_context': 'Broglio, in a statement Monday, also stipulated that any Catholic soldier assigned to the U.S. Army firing squad should ask to be excused from that duty, which he described as contrary to the teachings of the church. He joins other Catholic leaders in speaking out against the death penalty and the livestream plans.'}

{'text': '哈桑係一名陸軍精神科醫生，佢喺2009年喺德薩斯州胡德堡殺死13人，被裁定罪名成立，預定將於12月3日遭槍擊行刑處決。', 'paragraph_context': 'Hasan, an Army psychiatrist convicted of killing 13 people in 2009 at Fort Hood in Texas, is scheduled to be executed by firing squad on Dec. 3.'}

{'text': '布洛利奧回憶起，佢曾主持過喺襲擊中唯一喪生嘅平民麥可·格蘭特·卡希爾（Michael Grant Cahill）嘅葬禮。', 'paragraph_context': 'Broglio recalled that he presided over the funeral of Michael Grant Cahill, the only civilian killed in that attack.'}

{'text': '布洛利奧質問：「哈桑所犯嘅罪行『罪大惡極，但將佢嘅處決畫面公開畀公眾睇，究竟有乜意義？』」', 'paragraph_context': 'The crime committed by Hasan “was heinous, but does exposing the public to his execution serve any purpose?” Broglio asked.'}

{'text': '布洛利奧補充：「美軍喺世界上一般享有良好嘅聲譽，將佢哋同恐怖分子相提並論，向全世界直播一個坐輪椅嘅男人被處決嘅畫面，究竟有冇任何價值？」', 'paragraph_context': '“The US military generally enjoys a good reputation in the world,” Broglio added. “Is there really a value to throwing them in the same boat with terrorists by broadcasting the image of the execution of a man in a wheelchair to the whole world?”'}
